rows.title: The transporter list matches DR2.1: its layout, search, columns and shipped transporters
rows.detail: A trader choosing a transporter sees the list laid out as Design Release 2.1 lays it out: a visible 'Select a transporter' sub-heading above the search and the table, the 'Add a transporter' button beside the search rather than below the table, 'Not applicable' where a transporter has no approval number, and a search run from an icon button that also matches a transporter's type and status. With JavaScript the search filters the rows in the page; without it the icon button submits the term and the server filters. The service ships DR2.1's eight transporters (four commercial, four private), replacing the two placeholder commercial records. The list's error and no-match search states are checked for accessibility like its other states. Blocked: listing and searching transporters is transporter management, which waits on transporter requirements.
acceptanceCriteria: The transporter list shows a visible sub-heading 'Select a transporter' above the search box and the transporter table. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-015; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-076)

The radio group round the transporter table keeps the legend 'Select a transporter', visually hidden, so it is announced but not shown twice. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-022; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-083)

The search runs from an icon button whose accessible name is 'Search', beside the search box, in place of today's 'Search' text button. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-017; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-077; conflicts:c-006)

With JavaScript, typing in the search filters the listed rows in the page as the trader types; without JavaScript, pressing the icon button submits the term and the list comes back filtered by the server. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-003; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-078; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p18-024; conflicts:c-006)

Searching the list for 'Commercial', 'Private', 'Approved' or 'New' leaves only the transporters of that type or status; searching by name, address or approval number still works as before. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-018; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-078, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p9-046)

The secondary 'Add a transporter' button sits beside the search, above the transporter table, and still opens 'Choose a transporter type'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-020; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-104)
A transporter with no approval number shows 'Not applicable' in the Approval number column. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-084; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p9-044)

The list's commercial transporters are Yusen Logistics (Romania) SRL (Bulevardul General Paul Teodorescu 4, Sector 6, 061344 Bucharest, Romania; RO/BUCHAREST/T1/00092010), Roadtrain Ltd (The Roadtrain Complex, Bluebell Industrial Estate, Dublin 12, D12 P046, Republic of Ireland; IE/DUBLIN/T1/00092011), Danish Meat Export ApS (Vesterbrogade 12, 1620 Copenhagen, Denmark; DK/COPENHAGEN/T1/00081002) and Portuguese Livestock Lda (Rua Augusta 250, 1100-053 Lisbon, Portugal; PT/LISBON/T1/00071003), each Commercial and Approved; García Livestock Transport SL and J & G Campbell LTD are no longer listed. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-028, -p7-029, -p7-031, -p7-032; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p4-031; conflicts:c-057)

The list's private transporters are Aberdeen Livestock Ltd (15 Union Street, Aberdeen, AB11 5BN, United Kingdom; UK/ABERDEEN/T1/00092001; Approved), Romanian Agri Exports SRL (Bulevardul Unirii 22, 03083 Bucharest, Romania; RO/BUCHAREST/T1/00061004; New), Slovak Farm Export (Obchodná 2, 811 06 Bratislava, Slovakia; SK/BRATISLAVA/T1/00051005; Approved) and Finnish Livestock Oy (Mannerheimintie 10, 00100 Helsinki, Finland; FI/HELSINKI/T1/00041006; New), each saved with its address parts and country when chosen. rows.title: 'Choose a transporter type' matches DR2.1 and refuses a blank choice

rows.title: Saving an added transporter returns to the list with it chosen and a success banner; cancelling goes to the dashboard
rows.detail: After adding a private or commercial transporter from the journey, the trader goes back to the transporter list, where the new transporter is the first row, already chosen, under a one-time success banner. Both add forms gain a 'Cancel and return to dashboard' button that abandons the add, and keep what the trader typed if a save failed validation and they come back later. Added transporters belong to the organisation, so they stay on its list for later notifications. Blocked: adding transporters is transporter management, which waits on transporter requirements.
acceptanceCriteria: Saving a complete private or commercial transporter from the journey returns the trader to the transporter list, with the new transporter as the first row and already chosen. rows.title: Find a commercial transporter's Northern Ireland address with an address search
rows.detail: DR2.1 lets a trader adding a commercial transporter search for a Northern Ireland address instead of typing it, and fills the blank address fields from the address chosen. The search calls the same INS backend address lookup as the other address searches and keeps only results whose postcode starts 'BT'. It is built in its no-JavaScript form, a search the trader submits, with every field still shown. The lookup stub gains Northern Ireland addresses so the search and the fill can be seen in the fit suites and on the local stack. Blocked twice: on the address lookup becoming a real feature, and on transporter requirements.
acceptanceCriteria: In the fit suites, on the local stack and in CDP dev, the commercial transporter form offers an address search labelled 'Search for an address' with the placeholder 'Start typing...' and a search icon button named 'Search', and lists the addresses found under 'Address search results'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-093, -p7-094, -p7-098; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-127; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p9-059)

The search offers only Northern Ireland addresses: in the fit suites and on the local stack a search lists the lookup stub's addresses whose postcode starts 'BT' and none of its London addresses; in CDP dev it lists only results whose postcode starts 'BT'. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-178 to -p1-187; conflicts:c-218)

Choosing an address from the results fills address line 1, address line 2, town or city and postcode wherever the trader left the field blank, from what the lookup returns, and leaves the name, the county and every field the trader filled as they were. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-095; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-180; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p9-060)

rows.title: Save and continue on the transporter list goes on to 'Upload documents' in the journey run
rows.detail: In Design Release 2.1 the transporter list is followed by the documents page, so a trader running through the journey who chooses a transporter and saves moves on to 'Upload documents', at its real path, instead of landing on the overview. Opened from its overview task, the list still returns to the overview. This changes only where today's transporter list leads: the afternoon ruling of 9 October lets work over today's transporter step go ahead while transporter management waits, so the list itself stays as it is today.

rows.title: Adding a transporter started from the address book returns to the address book
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 lets a trader add a transporter from the address book: the add-a-transporter pages then lead back to the address book rather than to a notification. This draft covers the transporter pages' side of that route: the Back link, the cancel button and where a save lands when the add began in the address book, with the new transporter held as the organisation's. Blocked: the address book's transporter rows wait on transporter requirements.
acceptanceCriteria: When adding a transporter was started from the address book, the 'Choose a transporter type' Back link goes to the address book's add page. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-051)

When adding a transporter was started from the address book, both add forms' cancel button reads 'Cancel and return to address book' and goes to the address book filtered to transporters. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-082, -p7-083)

When adding a transporter was started from the address book, saving shows the address book's success message and the address book filtered to transporters, with the new transporter at the top carrying its type (Private or Commercial), address, approval number, country and contact details. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-110, -p7-111)
The new transporter is found by an address book search for its name, its type, its address, its approval number or its country. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-112)

A transporter added from the address book is on the transporter list of the organisation's next notification, ready to pick. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-146; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-093)

rows.title: Each transporter on the list links to its details page
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 lets a trader check a transporter's full record before choosing it. Once the real services hold transporter records with a details page, each row of the transporter list ends with a 'View details' link to that transporter's details page, which brings the trader back to the transporter list. The details page lives where the real services hold transporter records, in their conventions. Blocked: the address book's transporter rows wait on transporter requirements.

rows.title: A germinal products notification chooses its transporter from its own copy of today's transporter step
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1's germinal journey chooses its transporter from the same transporter page as the live-animals journeys. Following the 9 October rulings, the germinal products set gets its own copy of today's transporter step, taken from the live-animals set as it stands when the copy is built: the transporter list, 'Choose a transporter type' and both add forms, with the same content, controls and validation, on the germinal journey's own pages. It leaves out the unused approved commercial transporter register page. Added transporters belong to the organisation, not to a set, so a germinal notification offers the same transporters as a live-animals one. The live-animals transporter changes that wait on transporter requirements reach the germinal copy when the transporter area is re-distilled.
acceptanceCriteria: In a germinal products notification, the transport step shows the transporter list with the same caption, heading, search, 'Add a transporter' button, columns and shipped transporters as the live-animals transporter list shows at the time. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-101, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-102; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 49; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, -p1-009)

From the germinal transporter list, 'Add a transporter' opens a germinal 'Choose a transporter type' page, and each type opens its germinal add form, each with the same copy, buttons and error messages as the live-animals page it copies. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011, -p1-014; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 49)
Every germinal transporter page is at /germinal-products/notifications/{journeyId}/ followed by the live-animals page's slug. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006)

The germinal set has no 'Search for an approved commercial transporter' page: opening the register page's slug under a germinal notification shows the service's page not found. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 49; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-146)

Saving a complete transporter on a germinal add form makes it the notification's transporter and carries the germinal journey on from the germinal transporter list, as the live-animals add form does from its list. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-071; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 49)
